title: Soufeng Sanjie formula and its active ingredient formononetin alleviate osteoarthritis via PPARG-AKT-ERK1/2 promoted cartilage extracellular matrix anabolism.
authors: Liu, Qingyu; Nie, Ran; Fan, Bo; Wu, Wenhui; Ge, Jianbin; Zhu, Lizhong; Ye, Juan; Sun, Xiaoyan; Cao, Peng; Hu, Chunping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方及刺芒柄花素通过PPARG-AKT-ERK1/2通路促进软骨ECM合成缓解骨关节炎，虽含分子对接但核心为药物机制与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: In Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), osteoarthritis (OA) is referred to as "Gu Bi" (bone bi syndrome), which is characterized by chronic joint disease, cartilage damage, and deterioration of the extracellular matrix (ECM). The Soufeng Sanjie formula (SF), comprising Scolopendra, Scorpions, Astragali radix, and Black soybean seed coats, is traditionally employed in the treatment of "bone bi" disease and has been utilized in managing OA. Nonetheless, the effects of SF on ECM deterioration and cartilage destruction in OA, as well as its principal bioactive components, remain inadequately understood. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to investigate SF's therapeutic potential against ECM deterioration and cartilage destruction in OA, explore its underlying mechanisms, and identify its primary bioactive components. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A mouse model of knee OA was established via anterior cruciate ligament transection (ACLT). The analgesic effect of SF on arthritis pain was assessed by measuring cold pain thresholds. Cartilage damage was evaluated using Safranin O-fast green staining and the Osteoarthritis Research Society International (OARSI) scores. Immunohistochemical staining was employed to evaluate the influence of SF on cartilage metabolism, whereas cellular experiments were conducted to examine SF's capacity to enhance chondrocyte anabolism. The expression levels of SRY-box transcription factor 9 (SOX9), collagen type II alpha 1 (COL2A1), and aggrecan (ACAN) were analyzed using Western blotting and quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). Alcian blue staining was utilized to identify the bioactive components of SF that affect chondrocyte anabolism. This was further supported by preliminary analyses using network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques. RESULTS: SF has been shown to effectively reduce cartilage degradation and enhance the expression of SOX9, ACAN, and COL2A1 in the cartilage of OA mice. Furthermore, SF promotes ECM anabolism in chondrocyte cells, as evidenced by the increased production of chondrocyte acidic polysaccharides and elevated mRNA levels of SOX9, ACAN, and COL2A1. Additionally, Formononetin (FMN) was screened as a key compound of SF with the ability to enhance cartilage ECM anabolism. FMN significantly upregulated the expression of SOX9, ACAN, and COL2A1, alleviated pain symptoms, and reduced cartilage damage in OA mice. Network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses indicated that FMN targets the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARG), thereby activating the AKT and ERK1/2 signaling pathways in chondrocyte cells. And the chondroprotective effect of FMN is attenuated by PPARG inhibitors. Additionally, both CETSA and SPR analyses demonstrated direct binding between FMN and PPARG. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrated that SF significantly mitigated cartilage degradation in OA mice by ECM anabolism. FMN was identified as a potential active constituent of SF that supports chondrocyte anabolism and decelerates OA progression through the PPARG-AKT-ERK1/2 signaling pathway. Taken together, this herbal formulation offers new clinical treatment prospects for OA.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：在中医（TCM）中，骨关节炎（OA）被称为“骨痹”，其特征为慢性关节疾病、软骨损伤及细胞外基质（ECM）的退化。搜风散结方（SF）由蜈蚣、全蝎、黄芪和黑豆种皮组成，传统上用于治疗“骨痹”病，并已用于管理OA。然而，SF对OA中ECM退化和软骨破坏的影响及其主要生物活性成分仍了解不足。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨SF对OA中ECM退化和软骨破坏的治疗潜力，探索其潜在机制，并识别其主要生物活性成分。材料与方法：通过前交叉韧带横断（ACLT）建立小鼠膝OA模型。通过测量冷痛阈值评估SF对关节炎疼痛的镇痛效果。使用番红O-快绿染色和国际骨关节炎研究学会（OARSI）评分评估软骨损伤。采用免疫组织化学染色评估SF对软骨代谢的影响，而细胞实验则用于检查SF增强软骨细胞合成代谢的能力。使用Western blotting和定量逆转录聚合酶链反应（qPCR）分析SRY-box转录因子9（SOX9）、II型胶原α1（COL2A1）和聚集蛋白聚糖（ACAN）的表达水平。使用阿尔辛蓝染色鉴定SF中影响软骨细胞合成代谢的生物活性成分。这进一步通过使用网络药理学和分子对接技术的初步分析得到支持。结果：SF已被证明能有效减少软骨降解，并增强OA小鼠软骨中SOX9、ACAN和COL2A1的表达。此外，SF促进软骨细胞中ECM合成代谢，表现为软骨细胞酸性多糖产生增加以及SOX9、ACAN和COL2A1的mRNA水平升高。另外，芒柄花素（FMN）被筛选为SF中具有增强软骨ECM合成代谢能力的关键化合物。FMN显著上调SOX9、ACAN和COL2A1的表达，缓解疼痛症状，并减少OA小鼠的软骨损伤。网络药理学和分子对接分析表明，FMN靶向过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARG），从而激活软骨细胞中的AKT和ERK1/2信号通路。FMN的软骨保护作用被PPARG抑制剂减弱。此外，CETSA和SPR分析均证明FMN与PPARG之间存在直接结合。结论：我们的研究表明，SF通过ECM合成代谢显著减轻了OA小鼠的软骨降解。FMN被确定为SF中支持软骨细胞合成代谢并通过PPARG-AKT-ERK1/2信号通路减缓OA进展的潜在活性成分。总之，该草药配方为OA提供了新的临床治疗前景。
